name: How long does the finish work phase of a home addition typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does the finish work phase of a home addition typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of finish work for a home addition varies significantly based on the size and complexity of the project, as well as the materials chosen. Simple additions might take a few weeks, while larger, more custom projects could extend to several months. A practical tradeoff is that higher-end, custom finishes often require more time for ordering, fabrication, and precise installation compared to standard options. We provide a detailed timeline upfront, accounting for these specific choices.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish work duration depends on project size, complexity, and material choices, typically ranging from weeks to a few months.
